svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — landing page
svg.desc: Concept 10 Coupon Book landing page: one-line promise, a round coupon with carbon-copy moves and stamps, the six-step flow as a coupon book, and what the tool will not claim.
svg.text: Smart Warehouse Planner turns the Locations, Inventory and Transactions
files you already export into a printed move list: every move with
its rule and the numbers behind it. The tool suggests; you decide.
Demo on synthetic data · data as of 2026-09-30 · no account, no network calls at runtime
Six coupons, torn off in order
The plan always shows which steps are done and which remain. Nothing disappears: outdated recommendations are stamped VOID and stay visible.
Walk Path is an order, not metres.
You judge fit; keep in place declines.
Data is as of the newest transaction.
